content.text: All scale tests pass well within budget. Let me add a few more edge-case focus checks (net-zero quota edits, move-away-and-back, high revisions), then run the official public checker:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat >> scratch/focus_check.py <<'EOF'

# --- 15. quota edited twice landing back on committed value -> no pin violation
s15 = session(transactions=[{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['quota', 0, 3], ['quota', 0, 2]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}])
r15 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s15]})
t15 = r15['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
ok15 = t15['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 0] and t15['accepted'] is True
print('quota-net-zero:', 'ok' if ok15 else f"FAIL got {t15['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok15 else 1

# --- 16. move away and back in same transaction: no violation at all (fields net-unchanged)
s16 = session(transactions=[{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['move', 0, 1], ['move', 0, 0], ['bind', 0, 0]], 'query': {'groups': [0], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': [0]}}])
r16 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s16]})
t16 = r16['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
ok16 = (t16['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 0] and t16['accepted'] is True
        and t16['certificate']['groups'] == [[0, 2, 6, 2, 10, 2, 0, 3]])
print('move-and-back:', 'ok' if ok16 else f"FAIL {json.dumps(t16)[:400]}"); fails += 0 if ok16 else 1

# --- 17. move-and-back where intermediate group would mix: final state rules only
# t0 (dom0) moved to g1 (has t1 dom1) and back to g0 -> final fine -> accept
s17 = session(transactions=[{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['move', 0, 1], ['move', 1, 0], ['move', 0, 0], ['move', 1, 1]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}])
r17 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s17]})
t17 = r17['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
ok17 = t17['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 0] and t17['accepted'] is True
print('final-state-only:', 'ok' if ok17 else f"FAIL got {t17['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok17 else 1

# --- 18. high revision numbers
s18 = session(transactions=[{'revision': 999999999, 'edits': [], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}},
                            {'revision': 0, 'edits': [], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}])
r18 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s18]})
t18 = r18['sessions'][0]['transactions']
ok18 = (t18[0]['violations'] is None and t18[0]['revision'] == 0 and t18[0]['accepted'] is False
        and t18[1]['accepted'] is True and t18[1]['revision'] == 1)
print('high-revision:', 'ok' if ok18 else f"FAIL {json.dumps(t18)[:300]}"); fails += 0 if ok18 else 1

# --- 19. pin+move to same group with quota change of that group -> 1 violation (quota only)
s19 = session(transactions=[{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['move', 0, 0], ['quota', 0, 2], ['pin', 0, 0], ['pin', 2, 0]],
                             'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}])
r19 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s19]})
t19 = r19['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
# quota edit value 2 == committed 2 -> no quota change; moves/pins no-op -> [0,0,0,0] accept
ok19 = t19['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 0] and t19['accepted'] is True
print('same-values-no-violation:', 'ok' if ok19 else f"FAIL got {t19['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok19 else 1

# --- 20. weight edit on pinned task AND pin removal in one tx AND unpin quota protection: 1 violation
s20 = session(transactions=[{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['weight', 2, 9], ['pin', 2, 0]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}])
r20 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s20]})
t20 = r20['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
ok20 = t20['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 1] and t20['accepted'] is False
print('unpin-still-protected:', 'ok' if ok20 else f"FAIL got {t20['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok20 else 1

# --- 21. multiple sessions in one request, second illegal -> whole request invalid (no partial)
r21 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(), session(groups=[[2, 1], [2, 10], [1, 5]]), session()]})
ok21 = r21 == {'error': 'invalid'}
print('multi-session-partial:', 'ok' if ok21 else f'FAIL {json.dumps(r21)[:200]}'); fails += 0 if ok21 else 1

print('FAILURES' if fails else 'ALL FOCUS OK')
EOF
python3 scratch/focus_check.py
